archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: Diff adds and modifies Bash scripts, arrays, traps, awk parsing, and documented Bash 3.2-sensitive fences.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate Bash portability and runtime semantics across the changed shell scripts and SKILL.md command fences. Pay close attention to array expansion, set -e behavior, traps, mktemp cleanup, awk usage, local variables, and whether examples would run under the repository's supported Bash constraints. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: kv-streams
archetypes.rationale: The degraded-tools gate and final report paths rely on line-oriented KV stdout and diagnostic stderr contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether new and changed KV emissions preserve downstream parser assumptions, stream separation, and byte-compatibility for valid inputs. Check the placement of PRESENCE_INPUT_EMPTY, degraded explanation markers, line-count keys, and warning diagnostics against callers, harnesses, and documentation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: rehydration
archetypes.rationale: The primary plan risk is cross-Bash-block rehydration of external-tool presence and binary-found state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the durability and rehydration path for CODEX_PRESENT, CURSOR_PRESENT, CODEX_BINARY_FOUND, and CURSOR_BINARY_FOUND across implement and design flows. Verify that the documented fences, env writers, resume refreshes, and structural tests agree and do not accidentally depend on ambient shell state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pr-metrics
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds PR line-count computation and final-summary rendering paths that cross gh API, renderer, and fallback code.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new PR diff line-count computation and its integration into render-run-summary.sh and write-final-report.sh. Check behavior for missing PRs, unavailable repos, gh failures, pagination, numeric validation, larch-logs classification, and degraded renderer fallback consistency. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
